argon.check_detail: From Witness B's marked position (Depo Witness B 17:01 (5 ft 6 in tall), 41:10-41:20, 52:00-52:07 ("watched it the whole way, right up until it hit"), 1:54:34 (Exhibit 4 pen mark #2 centered at [8.5, 0, 9.0] m on south edge of bench shelter)) the line of sight to veh_car_a is blocked by occ_bench_shelter at t=9.9s (distance 29.9 m). Blocked from 25 of 25 positions within 2 m of Witness B's mark. Claim: "I had a clear view of the car the whole way in. I watched it right up until the moment it hit. Nothing was in the way."
argon.critique_summary: Witness B's testimony that she had a clear, unobstructed view of Vehicle A all the way to impact is contradicted by her own marked position on Exhibit 4.
